entryRule.side: Buy the YES or NO outcome whose current executable ask is >=1.25 cents below its own trailing 24-hour median midpoint.

results.conclusion: The training-calibrated historical dip rule produced signals, but none had a subsequent same-market book inside the fixed 2-second arrival window after the 1.721-second latency proxy. The saved capture therefore cannot validate an executable entry, and no trade P&L or profitability conclusion is available.

interpretation.decision: Do not deploy this rule from this capture.
interpretation.reason: 0/27 signals had a timely post-latency quote; treating the signal-time ask as filled would invent an unobserved fill.
interpretation.scope: The capture was examined for other policies; this is exploratory, not pristine out-of-sample profitability evidence.
interpretation.nextDataNeed: A subsequent capture with timely same-market book receipts and attributable fills or verified executable depth.
